title: A clip can be colour graded from Add Effect
goal: The video mocks put a colour grade in a clip's Effects list (Warm grade) and in the Add Effect menu (Color grade), and the app has no way to warm, cool, brighten or saturate a recording. Add a Color grade effect with the few controls an editor reaches for, keyable like every other effect value, so a dull screen recording or b-roll can be given a look in two clicks.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video.html line 515 (Effects list 'Warm grade · adjust'), line 570 (add-effect menu 'Color grade', ic-sliders), line 1071 (keyable Saturation, 0-300%, still 100). video-compositing.html lines 262/306/346 show a grade as its own layer with a blend mode and a matte; that layer form and the 'grade.look' Library preset are NOT this task (open thread). Code today: the only colour effects are lens kinds Greyscale, Invert, Brightness (Sources/PhotonzCore/Lens.swift:13-21, LensFilter.swift:52-63); Add Effect menu at Sources/Photonz/EffectsListInspector.swift:759-792. Model the effect in PhotonzCore (pure, Codable, tested first) and its CIFilter chain in PhotonzRender (CITemperatureAndTint, CIExposureAdjust, CIColorControls). TDD for Core and Render. Perf note in the commit: the composite path, target under 16 ms for a 12 MP frame. Copy: Mac title case, no em dashes, label controls, no sentences in the panel.
acceptance: Add Effect on a picked clip lists Color grade; adding it shows a Color grade row in the clip's Effects list with the mock's 'adjust' meta, and its section offers Temperature, Tint, Exposure, Contrast and Saturation, each a slider with a number field
Each of those values has a keyframe diamond and can be animated like any other effect value; the effect shows in playback, scrubbing and the exported MP4 alike

A measured check in a walk: on the sample recording, Temperature at its warm end makes the mean red minus blue of a rendered frame rise by a clear margin over the untouched frame (threshold set by measuring), and returning every value to its middle gives a frame identical to the untouched one
Try path, no flag changed from Next defaults: open the sample recording, pick the clip, Effects, Add Effect, Color grade, drag Temperature right

Audit written under queue/audits/ with a before and after frame on one contact sheet and a decision card linking it so the user judges the look; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: review before building: a Premiere user looks for Lumetri's Basic Correction (Temperature, Tint, Exposure, Contrast, Saturation) under effects on the clip; the app had none. The mock offers Color grade in the Effects plus and Saturation (0-300, still 100) in the property catalogue, both deliverable with the existing effects list and key model, so no prerequisite task. A grade that arrives at its middles reads as a dead press, so it arrives as the mock's Warm grade (T20, C10, S110); filed as a card for the user to judge.

built: ColorGradeEffect + EffectKind/AddableEffect/LayerEffect .colorGrade (PhotonzCore/ColorGrade.swift, LayerEffects.swift), five keyable MotionProperty values gradeTemperature..gradeSaturation (Saturation offered on every picture at 100, a key off the middle brings a grade in), ColorGradeFilter in PhotonzRender (exposure, then white point in mireds +-100 at the ends, then CIColorControls), applied right after a chroma key so shadows and borders follow the graded picture; nothing drawn at all when every value is at its middle. Panel: ColorGradeEffectRows, slider + box per value with a key diamond in the name's column (new LayerStyleSlider.keyed / PanelFieldRow.lead). Flag next-color-grade, on in Next. New walk step measureColor (FrameColor in core).

verified: ColorGradeTests (14), ColorGradeRenderTests (7), ColorGradeExportTests (real MP4: grey at the first key, warm at the last, between half way), FrameColorTests; walk color-grade-warms-a-clip-walk green at Next defaults: warm end raises red over blue +67.6 over untouched (bar 30; the arrival look alone is +12.2 and the untouched frame 0, so both fail it), every value back at its middle is identical pixel for pixel, diamond and lane follow keys, MP4 written. Perf (render incl. readback): 1920x1080 3.0 ms plain vs 2.8 graded; 4000x3000 14.4 vs 14.2-14.7 ms.

review after building, on the probe captures: first pass the diamond pushed the label column right and halved the slider tracks; moved it into the name's column so tracks keep their width. A click on a short track cannot land exactly on 100% Saturation, so the grade rows' number boxes have a walk name and the walk types exact middles, as a person would. Pictures looked at: contact sheet (untouched slate blue, arrival faintly warm, T100 strongly orange with the white card yellow, put back identical) and captures 1-4.

left rough, not filed: the plus menu shows words without the mock's icons (every row of it always has; no rule or task covers menu icons, and it is cosmetic). Walks touched: properties-pane, properties-reset, key-a-title-s-scale counts +1 for Saturation; all three re-run green. Filed follow-up a-colour-grade-can-be-its-own-track-over-the-cli for the compositing mock's grade layer + matte + look preset.
